 Former President Obama speaking at rally in Morrow today
 By Marc Teichner  and  Deidra Dukes 2026 Elections Updated  October 28, 2026 12:43 PM EDT Published  October 28, 2026 6:42 AM EDT Updated  October 28, 2026 12:43 PM EDT ▾ The Brief
 Former President Barack Obama is scheduled to hold a rally in the metro Atlanta area on Wednesday for Georgia Democrats Keisha Lance Bottoms and U.S. Sen. Jon Ossoff. 
 Former Vice President Kamala Harris is expected to campaign in Georgia Thursday and Friday. 
 President Donald Trump has made two recent Georgia visits to support Republican candidates Rick Jackson and Mike Collins. 
 ATLANTA - Former President Barack Obama and former Vice President Kamala Harris are making campaign stops in Georgia this week as Democrats seek to boost turnout ahead of next Tuesday’s midterm election.
 Obama to hold Atlanta rally
 Obama is appearing at an afternoon rally in the metro Atlanta area on Wednesday to mobilize voters for former Atlanta mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms, a candidate for governor, and Sen. Jon Ossoff, the incumbent U.S. senator. The event follows similar Obama appearances in Ohio and Michigan.
 Doors are scheduled to open at 4 p.m. at The Arena at Southlake, which seats approximately 8,000, in Morrow, which is in Clayton County. 
 Harris plans Georgia visit
 Harris is set to begin a multiday visit to Georgia this week, with events expected to continue at least through Friday.
 The former vice president is expected to join the Georgia Democrats in Macon and to attend a rally with Sen. Jon Ossoff. Details have not been released at this time.
 Trump has campaigned for Georgia Republicans
 Trump has made two recent visits to Georgia to campaign for Republican candidates Rick Jackson and Mike Collins. One of the visits was in Perry over the weekend.
 RELATED: Trump stumps for Collins, Jackson in Perry rally 
 FOX 5 Atlanta will provide live coverage throughout the day of former President Obama's visit.
 EARLIER REPORT 
 Obama, Harris campaign in Georgia ahead of midterms 
 Former President Barack Obama and former Vice President Kamala Harris are making campaign stops in Georgia this week as Democrats seek to boost turnout ahead of next Tuesday’s midterm election. FOX 5 Atlanta's Marc Teichner reporting. 
 The Source
 Information for this story came from official channels and previous FOX 5 Atlanta reporting.
